review.reviewBody: Bro bro, this is next level than others. Tried it and it's wow, why wow. I'm working on a project which needed to be done urgently as a working MVP and it helped me ship that. Can't share the project link or details but if it worked, chances are we'll close 9 figure deal.

In one uninterrupted evening, I was able to build a full-featured, enterprise-grade platform 'Quantum Social AI' from zero to working prototype, entirely on Blink.new. What used to take a team and a roadmap, I did solo in a few hours. Blink didn't just accelerate the process-it amplified it.

Dude, I'm sure you're getting a lot of messages and people reaching out to you! I wanted to thank you for releasing Blink, I was able yesterday (while on holiday) to build this web app I've been trying to build for the last year. It has everything I need to. I honestly tried them all Bolt, Lovable, Replit, V0, Emergent etc... they get close... but your software actually did it! Not sure how.. but it works!!
The builder is really cool. I have gotten further in 5 days than I have in a year.

review.reviewBody: Wow, Kai, this product is unbelievable! I built a full-featured GPT 4.0 clone, wrote a legal brief, and even analyzed an X-ray image - all in less than 25 minutes. This would have taken a team weeks.

I was not only able to make an AI tool app, I was also able to create an entire business consulting firm (ran by AI) with just 3 prompts, ~20 min, and it's about 80% functional. So far, easily the best app builder I've seen thus far.

I pit Lovable, against Bolt, and Blink to create a website.
Ability to follow instructions: Lovable ⭐⭐, Bolt ⭐⭐, Blink ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐.
Credits utilization: Lovable ⭐⭐, Bolt ⭐, Blink ⭐⭐⭐⭐.
Final Output: Lovable ⭐, Bolt ⭐, Blink ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐.
Blink.new, you have my heart ❤️.

I'm truly impressed with this so far - you have no idea how much money you are saving me. You are creating a product that not only changes the lives of ambitious founders with no upfront capital but also those whose ideas aim to benefit others.

I was messing with Blink as well, built a consumer tool super fast. Now I'm testing it with my wife. ✌️ It works lol. I've tried other vibe coding platforms before and had moderate success, but with Blink, stuff just exploded (8 straight hours).
Ya me and some friends started using Blink.new the other day to build out an MVP of our idea and I'm actually so impressed by how well it turned out. This thing you're working on is awesome bro!
Hi Kai. I tried out Blink against Lovable, Bolt & Base44. Very impressive! There is a lot less prompting involved, and it makes fewer mistakes compared to the other AI app builders out there.

As a new customer, I want to leave Lovable and move to Blink. The code quality from Lovable was so poor it didn't even pass error checks. With Blink, I see strict code standards, stability, and higher reliability.

I upgraded again. I have a demo next week so I'm desperate for it to work. Lovable keeps breaking my app so I'm starting again. Setting up Stripe was taking me forever between Lovable/Clerk/Supabase and I've done it in less than 5 messages on Blink.

Cancelled my other subscription... subscribed to yours. Made the practice mode, but thought of having video or voice feature where users can interact while playing. Great way to connect people globally. By the way it's a Filipino mahjong on the site.
Sir Yes Sir! 7 hours and $70 later, I have an internal Talent Acquisition tool that does work.

I tried building some really cool simple projects when I found Blink.new and it really blew my mind how well put together everything was. Minimal errors and significant difference even compared to other platforms. It actually one-shots an entire MVP with no errors. Honestly, it's S tier.

I've been using your product all night and got the paid version as soon as I ran out of messages lol. This is by far the best app builder I've used yet. Absolutely brilliant the way you have it set up.
Your firebase and supabase integrations are the best! I had never seen such seamless integration with Bolt and Lovable. Also, the UI game is smooth, and it almost always gets it right.

I tried Blink. Man, it did as you said it would. Built an online mahjong game right after we messaged earlier. Pretty surprised how it handled even the UI/UX. Kudos and congratulations!
Came across your LinkedIn yesterday and decided to test out Blink.new. I absolutely love it! Blink beats Lovable and all other competitors easily!
I'm a no-code builder and have worked with tools like Bolt, Lovable, Replit, and recently explored Blink. Honestly, I see more potential in Blink than in most others I've tried.
Congrats and fair play to you! I have had another go, and true to your word, you have delivered! Way superior to Replit and a nicer user experience than Claude Code.

Actually after posting the question, I thought of giving it a try, and to my surprise, it gave me full working software. I thought the software is very complex to build by Blink. But it was just wow. It is more user friendly than Bolt and Replit.

Thanks Kai. You are going to blow up in users very soon if you are not there already. I moved from Lovable because your system produces a better style. You have something special here Kai. I never pay for software and you got me.
Well, I tried Blink and can finally say it's better than other tools. It solved the errors more efficiently. You have a chance to break the market for sure.
I used Blink.new, Lovable, and Base44 for my project to compare how it would generate UI and overall UX - amazed with the result that I received from Blink and it's far better than the other 2.

I have tried other tools as I have been using all the others since their launch but I just checked Blink post on LI yesterday and tried to give it a shot. It worked really well compared to all others.
Collaborating with you was truly one of the best experiences I've had. I absolutely loved the output from Blink. It's a goldmine for people like me who have no background in coding.
Great app, really well done! I am using it to make a tower defense game and am shocked at my progress. Most of the charm of my game is in its audio, it is Irish drinking culture centric!
Hey Kai, super impressed with the ease of just getting started with Blink.new. There was that delightful onboarding and accomplishment feeling that I felt!
